raw:
US-10-05 is ready. It is one commit, 98f0db8, on `feature/US-10-05`, branched off the local `main`, with a clean tree. The story's four test cases (TC-10-32 to TC-10-35) pass on that exact head. fmt, clippy and the whole `cargo test --workspace` pass. Nothing was pushed.

**What changed:**
- **No time given** ("Spotkanie z Michałem w sobotę"): the window opens on Saturday 31 October with the time empty and the cursor in it. Save stays unavailable until a time is typed or All day is ticked. The end then follows at the event's length.
- **No day given** ("Lunch o 13"): the window opens at 13:00–13:30 with the day empty and the cursor in it. Save waits for a day.
- **Where:** the "New event" window shows these empty fields only when the description left something out; otherwise its time row is unchanged. The full editor leaves the same start fields empty. When a start field is empty it now says "Type the start date." or "Type the start time or choose all day." instead of "can't be read".
- **A named calendar** ("w kalendarzu Praca"): the model now returns the calendar's name. The app picks the first calendar in side-panel order with that name, ignoring letter case, among those a new event can go to. Disabled, read-only and hidden calendars count as not found. If none fits, the default calendar is used and a note under the picker says `Calendar "Praca" not found — using Work`.
- **The model's rules** gain a "no day" answer.
  - A part of the day alone, such as "Trening wieczorem", still means today. This keeps TC-10-11 and the module's acceptance criterion; the app enforces it itself because `gemma4:e4b` answers that sentence with no day.
  - I checked the new rules against the real `gemma4:e4b` on this machine. The test set scored dates 96 % and all fields 90 %, above the thresholds.

**Test set change.** "Kawa z Bartkiem o 15" in the test set used to expect today; it now expects no day, with the model's new recorded answer. Four sentences were added. The test set file is `crates/core/src/described_cases.json` and the test set run is TC-10-18.

**Before you push:** check by eye the empty day/time fields and the calendar note in the light and dark themes, as the story's technical notes ask.
